learning_objective: 🎯 Master the art of collecting, organizing, and visualizing data to spot amazing trends and tell true stories using numbers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Data is just a collection of facts, numbers, or measurements. Whether it is the heights of your classmates or the number of centuries scored by a cricketer, organizing data is the first step to understanding it!

Looking at a huge list of numbers can be boring and confusing. That is why we use bar graphs, dot plots, and pie charts to draw a clear visual picture. A good graph lets your brain understand the math in seconds.
Sometimes we need one single number to describe a whole group. We use averages (the mean) to find the central, 'normal' value. Just add all the numbers up and divide by how many there are!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Weather Watcher
fun_activity.instructions: Record the highest temperature in your city every day for one full week. Create a beautiful bar graph to connect the dots and show which day was the absolute hottest!

quick_recap: ⭐ Data is a collection of facts used to analyze situations and make decisions.
⭐ Graphs turn raw numbers into easy-to-read pictures.
⭐ An average gives us a summary of the whole dataset in just one number.
